summary: Iteration 149 - Comprehensive 100+ User Simulation Test for MeetFlow clinic platform. Tested Chat, Meetings, Schedule Polls, News, Surveys, Status System, and Edge Cases. 22 tests passed, 1 skipped (parallel messaging due to rate limits). Found 1 potential security bug: non-member can send messages to conversations.

critical.issue: Non-member can send messages to conversation - returns 200 instead of 404. This is a potential security issue where users can send messages to conversations they're not part of.

minor.issue: Rate limit of 5/minute makes bulk user creation difficult for testing. Consider adding admin bypass or bulk creation endpoint.
Rate limit of 10/minute makes bulk user login difficult for load testing.

integration_issues.issue: /terminplanung redirects to /dashboard instead of showing schedule polls page
